components.prompt: Create an ORIGINAL production-ready sprite component sheet for CHAOS HARRIER MK II, an aggressive enemy laser gunship for a 16-bit vertical arcade space shooter. Crisp detailed pixel art, dark chromium armor, deep violet panels, cyan reactor lights, tiny red warning accents. Top-down orthographic, nose pointing DOWN toward the player, symmetrical imposing swept wings and long sharp center fuselage. Transparent background. EXACTLY FOUR isolated components in a spacious 2x2 grid, no touching or overlapping: TOP LEFT a complete main hull with wing attachment sockets and bright circular cyan core, NO wing guns mounted, no exhaust or beams; TOP RIGHT a single long detachable armored wing laser cannon with round rear pivot and downward muzzle, mechanical barrel, purple armor, cyan chamber; BOTTOM LEFT a single separate compact central nose laser emitter facing downward; BOTTOM RIGHT an independent cyan-purple engine thruster flame pointing UP. Every component entirely inside its own quadrant with wide empty margins, full silhouettes not clipped. Hull is largest, other components use their own quadrant at readable size. Absolutely NO laser beams, no projectiles, no words, no labels, no border or grid lines, no shadows/background, no watermark. These parts will be independently rigged and animated in the game.

frames.prompt: Use the reference sheet as the EXACT design identity for a production animation sprite sheet. Draw exactly 16 sprites arranged in an evenly spaced 4 COLUMN by 4 ROW grid on a square transparent canvas. Each cell is identical in size, each part centered with wide 15% transparent padding on ALL sides. Do not let any pixel touch a cell edge. NO grid lines, labels, words, beams, long light streaks or projectiles. Crisp 16-bit pixel art, hard stepped edges, no smooth painting. All ships and guns face DOWN. ROW 1: four aligned frames of ONLY the same purple chromium main hull (no mounted guns): 1 idle cyan core dim, 2 idle cyan core bright and vents slightly open, 3 attack-charge core white cyan and shutters fully open, 4 cooldown dim purple core and vents closing. Preserve exact hull size, wing silhouette, two circular wing gun sockets, symmetry and center anchor across these four frames; NO tilting, banking, rotating or sliding. ROW 2: four aligned frames of the same SINGLE detachable long wing cannon: 1 idle closed casing, 2 charging open cyan chamber, 3 firing mechanical recoil barrel pulled backward and vents flared but NO emitted beam or muzzle flash, 4 cooling barrel extended again. Preserve circular rear pivot at same coordinate across these frames and aim barrel downward. ROW 3: four aligned frames of the same compact central emitter: idle, open charging collar cyan, recoiled firing collar white cyan with NO emitted beam, closed cooling collar. ROW 4: four animation frames of the separate purple/cyan engine flame with small engine nozzle at BOTTOM, flame flickering UP, same nozzle anchor, shorter/longer/shorter/medium. Use bright cyan whites sparingly, retain dark outlines and violet armor. Each row uses one consistent scale. Entire sprites fully visible with all tips inside their cell. Nothing may cross between cells. This is one complete matched animation sheet, not four unrelated ship designs.
